comment: Lain knows evidence and she teaches it well.  Rule -> Understanding -> Application.  Come to class and prepare with problems and you'll be fine.
Interesting material and discussion, but she assumes WAY too much about what is "reasonable". A tough grader! One might wonder if she was a rural county deputy sheriff in a former life.

I found the subject matter boring, but she definitely tried to get us interested in it with stories and panelists.  She was very helpful and tried really hard to explain difficult concepts in a clear manner.  There were some topics that were covered at an excruciatingly slow pace though because she wanted to make sure everyone got it.
Her exams are much like Eisen's--only god knows what she's looking for.  Her mightier-than-thou attitude gets very old very quickly.  She could be a good prof, but E&E taught me hearsay.

Great class. Prof. Lain organized the class thoughtfully and made the material very manageable.  Bonus of real-life war stories, interesting snippets of real-life applications.  Exam was straightforward, fairly graded.
She knows her stuff, was accessible to answer questions, and was a good professor. Test was a bit difficult, but no more so than most.
Great professor with a great method.  I also had her for civ pro and she was did great with tough material.  Very easy to talk to in class or away from school.
